title: Fix flipping of gate direction in transpiler for CZ gate
notes: GateDirection could fail on a valid symmetric CZ orientation; the documented manifestation is transpilation rejection.

title: Use float-epsilon calculation in Sabre best scores
notes: Floating-point tie instability could change Sabre's best-swap set with iteration order and break RNG-compatible routing, without a single semantically wrong output.

title: Fix random seed initialization between runs in SabreSwap
notes: With no user seed, reusing the prior seed made repeated SabreSwap runs repeat unintentionally; this is a cross-run randomness/determinism fault, not a wrong circuit.

title: Enable simplifying 1q runs and 2q blocks in transpile() without target
notes: Without a target, optimization levels 1-3 could leave simplifiable 1q runs/2q blocks in the compiled circuit, producing unnecessarily long output.

title: Fix add_calibration bug
notes: Parameterized calibration formatting mismatched between QuantumCircuit and DAGCircuit, causing the example circuit to fail during transpile.

title: Make BarrierBeforeFinalMeasurements deterministic
notes: Unordered-set iteration made BarrierBeforeFinalMeasurements depend on PYTHONHASHSEED, so fixed transpiler seeds could produce different outputs.

title: Fix handling of BackendV1 simulators in PassManagerConfig.from_backend
notes: BackendV1 simulators can have missing properties/defaults, which caused PassManagerConfig.from_backend construction to error instead of transpiling.

title: Fix explicitly calibrated gates in GateDirection
notes: GateDirection rejected an explicitly calibrated custom 2q gate when it could not flip its direction, raising TranspilerError on the valid trigger.

title: Fix basis_gates and coupling_map backend override in transpile()
notes: BackendV2 target precedence ignored explicit basis/coupling overrides; the linked custom-gate case ends in an unrolling error, so crash/rejection takes precedence.

title: Fix UnrollCustomDefinitions handling of empty definitions
notes: UnrollCustomDefinitions silently discarded a custom instruction definition that was empty except for its global phase.

title: Fix CheckMap with control-flow builder nested conditionals
notes: CheckMap could spuriously raise DAGCircuitError on a valid nested conditional because classical-bit ordering was not composed correctly.

title: Fix UnassignedDurationError of update_from_instruction_schedule_map
notes: Updating durations from an instruction schedule map could raise UnassignedDurationError when schedule duration was parameterized.

title: limiting matrix-based commutativity check
notes: The matrix-based commutativity path could attempt an enormous allocation and crash with a memory-allocation error on large gates.

title: Removed 2pi wrapping for global phase parameter
notes: Wrapping a parameterized global phase modulo 2pi could raise TypeError during transpilation; the documented crash takes precedence over the phase aspect.

title: Track Sabre decay heuristic on physical qubits
notes: Sabre's decay heuristic tracked virtual rather than physical-qubit depth, so its routing-quality objective did not correspond to output depth; semantics remained valid.

title: Use only discrete-basis translations in GateDirection
notes: GateDirection could insert non-basis continuous translations and leave BasisTranslator unable to translate the result, causing transpilation errors.

title: Allow dynamical decoupling pass to work on circuits with pulse gates
notes: The dynamical-decoupling pass errored when a gate in the DD sequence had a pulse calibration, preventing compilation of the trigger circuit.

title: Fix input normalisation of transpile(initial_layout=...)
notes: transpile(initial_layout=range(...)) failed input normalization and raised a TranspilerError instead of accepting the valid layout-like input.

title: Ensure TemplateOptimization returns native-symbolic objects
notes: TemplateOptimization returned ParameterExpressions with the wrong symbolic backing type; the demonstrated fault is an internal representation contract while circuit semantics remain intact.

title: Don't substitute ideal gates in target with Optimize1qGatesDecomposition
notes: The pass unnecessarily replaced a target-supported ideal gate even though the alternative had the same gate count and error and was semantically valid; I treat this as an output-invisible substitution/target contract rather than a quality regression.

title: Raise error eagerly on bad unitary synthesis method
notes: A nonexistent unitary-synthesis plugin was only rejected when the pass manager ran; the fault is deferred invalid-input rejection, so it remains a compilation-failure channel.

title: Fixed bug in OptimizeSwapBeforeMeasure
notes: OptimizeSwapBeforeMeasure could incorrectly remove/transform a SWAP before measurement and change the measured outcomes of the compiled circuit.

title: Fix SetLayout to error with invalid int list input
notes: Invalid duplicate integer-list layouts were accepted by SetLayout only to fail later; the manifestation is a transpilation error on invalid input.

title: Fix PropertySet re-use in BasePassManager.run
notes: Reusing stale PropertySet analysis data across PassManager runs caused the linked valid circuit to raise TranspilerError; documented failure takes precedence over possible miscompilation.

title: Fix transpilation of control flow to no hardware
notes: Control-flow circuits transpiled without hardware could be rejected as unsupported (for example if_else), so the trigger fails to compile.

title: Remove old graph structure during EquivalenceLibrary.set_entry
notes: EquivalenceLibrary.set_entry updated entries but left stale graph edges, so BasisTranslator ignored the replacement rule; the shown old/new decompositions remain equivalent, making this an internal-library contract fault.

title: Fix custom constraints in transpile with BackendV2
notes: With BackendV2, backend target data could override user scheduling constraints such as dt, yielding the wrong duration/scheduling property while leaving the circuit output map unchanged.

title: Fix unnecessary serialisation of PassManager in serial contexts
notes: PassManager was unnecessarily serialized with dill even in serial execution, adding compile-time overhead without changing the emitted circuit.

title: Make dense layout algorithm deterministic when run in parallel
notes: Dense layout tie resolution depended on parallel completion order, so otherwise equivalent runs could choose different layouts; the fix makes parallel results deterministic.

title: Don't run ElidePermutation if routing is disabled
notes: ElidePermutation removed SWAPs even when routing was disabled, turning an already mapped/routed circuit into an unmapped output and degrading physical layout quality.

title: Keep identical summands when running FindCommutingPauliEvolutions.
notes: FindCommutingPauliEvolutions dropped coefficients of repeated identical Pauli summands, changing the implemented evolution rather than only its representation.

title: Fix OptimizeCliffordT producing non-unitarily-equivalent output when basis excludes sx/sxdg
notes: OptimizeCliffordT could emit a circuit explicitly shown to be non-unitarily-equivalent when sx/sxdg were excluded from the basis.

title: Fix sx resynthesis of negative angles in CommutativeCancellation
notes: CommutativeCancellation used the wrong sx resynthesis for negative angles, producing a miscompiled unitary.

title: Use target error rates when selecting Euler basis in Optimize1qGatesDecomposition
notes: Optimize1qGatesDecomposition ignored target error rates when choosing among Euler bases, so it could select a substantially higher-error equivalent decomposition.

title: Fix commuting2q block parameter preservation
notes: Commuting2qBlock hardcoded params=[] and lost the parameters of parametric gates; the linked reproduction directly shows a corrupted internal params property.

title: Consistent identity removal for ConsolidateBlocks
notes: ConsolidateBlocks used an inconsistent identity test and could retain sequences equivalent to identity (including up to global phase), leaving unnecessary gates in otherwise correct output.
